newsitem.title: USA: White House says has been quite generous on budget.
newsitem.headline: White House says has been quite generous on budget.

text.p: The White House believes that it has been "quite generous" in its budget discussions with congressional Republicans, White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters on Wednesday.

Asked to comment on Republican Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott's earlier suggestion that it was time for the White House to offer some concessions in the talks, McCurry replied: "It is often better to give than to receive, but we feel like we have been quite generous in the discussions to date."
